overview_description.description:
Menakart.com is an Online Shopping E-commerce Website in Middle East. Menakart caters to the entire GCC region and have all major categories including Laptops, Mobiles, Cameras, Gift Cards, Games, Grocery, Fashion & Household.

Menakart provides delivery to United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain and also does Worldwide delivery. All products are genuine and authentic with One Year Warranty on Mobiles, Laptops and Cameras.

Latest brands in Mobiles include Samsung, Apple, HTC, Nokia, LG, BlackBerry. All leading brands of Laptops from Apple & Microsoft are available at lowest prices. Games consists of all platforms including Playstation 3, Playstation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and Xbox 360.

Menakart provides Free delivery in UAE if the value is greater than AED 100 and various payment options including Visa, Master, PayPal, Cash on Delivery are available. Easy payment plan is available with leading banks for customers.
